none: PAS NLM-309DBB: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CON[---]. Reverse description: two soldiers with one standard between them; standard has large vexillum with prominent Chi Rho. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA E]XER [CITVS]. Diameter: 13.8mm, Weight: 0.75gms, die axis: 12
